mapper.select: select ID, USER_ID, AGENT_ID, STATUS, PURPOSE, CREATED_AT, EXPIRED_AT from AGENT_TASK where ID = #{task_id}
select ID, USER_ID, AGENT_ID, STATUS, PURPOSE, CREATED_AT, EXPIRED_AT from AGENT_TASK where AGENT_ID = #{agent_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AGENT_TASK (user_id, agent_id, status, purpose, created_at, expired_at) values (#{user_id}, #{agent_id}, #{status}, #{purpose}, #{created_at}, #{expired_at})
mapper.delete: delete from AGENT_TASK where ID = #{id} and USER_ID = #{user_id}
